39: 
40: The following require explicit human approval:
41: 
42: - Adoption or amendment of this Constitution.
43: - Modification of governing permissions or security policies.
44: - Promotion of research findings into the authoritative knowledge archive.
45: - Destructive or materially disruptive changes to protected projects.

47: - External publication, transmission or disclosure of protected information.
48: - Expansion of agent privileges beyond approved boundaries.

218: ## ARTICLE V — SECURITY, PERMISSIONS AND SYSTEM INTEGRITY
219: 
220: ### 5.1 Least Privilege
221: 
222: Agents shall receive only the permissions required for their assigned tasks.
223: 
224: ### 5.2 Protected Operations
225: 
226: Operations affecting system configuration, software installation, credentials, protected source code, external communications or destructive file changes require explicit authorization unless a narrowly defined prior authorization exists.
227: 
228: ### 5.3 Execution Boundaries
229: 
230: Where applicable, technical controls should include:
231: 
232: - Filesystem access restrictions.
233: - Network access controls.
234: - Sandboxed execution.
